description: covers — config:recommended, gomod indirect security updates, pinned
action digests, the non-major automerge batch, the major-update
label — is dropped here rather than repeated. What's left below is
genuinely repo-specific; each block says why.

lockFileMaintenance.description: The preset does not run lockfile maintenance; go.sum needs it kept current independently of any dependency bump.

packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (the fleet job from truvity/ci-caller): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock — language minor capped by golangci-lint's build Go, patch = the newest release of that line, never downward. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: The `security` label is load-bearing: .github/workflows/auto-release.yaml releases immediately on a push whose merged PR carries it. The preset does not set this label, so every repo wires it locally.
